title: AWS Marketplace Event Ingestion Error
description: Error body for POST /api/v1/billing/marketplace/events. Every error branch returns exactly `{"error": <fixed literal>}` -- no `success`/`message` envelope fields. 404 = integration disabled; 401 = the X-Traigent-Marketplace-Secret header did not match (hmac.compare_digest); 400 = the body was not a JSON object or was missing a truthy `id`. See src/routes/marketplace_routes.py:events.
